title: ACE-BOOT.sys — research artifact
summary: ACE-BOOT.sys is a kernel-driver artifact in Aftermath Labs' July 2026 Tencent VM analysis. Its name is documented, but a boot-start lifecycle is not established merely by the word BOOT in that name.
